verdict.rationale: BILL's first-party developer docs describe a public v3 API that explicitly covers Spend & Expense: budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements. They also document S&E webhook events, a sandbox, recipes, and an llms.txt for AI consumption. Concrete endpoint examples are mostly from AP, though, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at common paths. Missing for 10: S&E-specific endpoint reference detail in evidence, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
